audience: marketing and CRM teams that run text and email campaigns on Attentive

useCases.title: Check whether a subscriber can receive a campaign
useCases.text: Look up a subscriber by phone number or email. See the text and email channels they are opted in to, and their custom attribute values.

useCases.title: Review segments and their clear status
useCases.text: List segments changed since a date. Then open one segment and check the status of its latest clear-segment request.

useCases.title: Track a bulk subscriber import
useCases.text: Check the state and totals of a bulk ingestion job. List the webhooks and the event types they receive, such as sms.subscribed.

useCases.title: Create or rename a segment
useCases.text: Create an empty segment, or change the name or description of one. Segments can drive campaigns and journeys, so check the name first.

useCases.title: Unsubscribe a subscriber from text marketing
useCases.text: Unsubscribe one subscriber from text or email subscriptions. This changes consent, so the subscriber stops receiving those messages.

useCases.title: Archive a segment that is no longer used
useCases.text: Read the segment, then archive it. An archived segment leaves list results and can be restored in Attentive. Campaigns or journeys that use it may change.
